  ⟦Set up Bint~~~~~⟧  ⟦Step 2/7 · ⟦Recording hooks~~~~~~⟧~~~~⟧                                                                              
                                                                                                                                            
  ⟦Install hooks so Bint records agent runs (written to a local queue only, no model calls). Hooks live in the harness settings             
  files.~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧                                                                              
                                                                                                                                            
▸ (•) ⟦Yes~~⟧                                                                                                                               
  ( ) ⟦No~⟧                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                            
  ⟦Where to install hooks:~~~~~~~~~~⟧                                                                                                       
  (•) ⟦local — this machine only, added to .gitignore~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧                                                                   
  ( ) ⟦project — the project settings file (committed for the team)~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧                                                
  ( ) ⟦user — your user settings in the home directory~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~⟧
